Definition: to be (transitively, do or make) good (or well) in the widest sense
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be good, be pleasing, be joyful, be beneficial, be pleasant, be favourable, be happy, be right; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be pleasant, be delightful; 1a2) to be glad, be joyful; 1a3) to be better; 1a4) to be well with, be good for; 1a5) to be pleasing; 1b) (Hiphil) to do well, do good, act right, act rightly
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
